title: Beyond feature attribution: Recovering latent interaction structures in machine learning models via localized CBFI
abstract: arXiv:2610.34962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Understanding individual predictions in complex tabular models remains challenging, as existing additive frameworks like SHAP and LIME often obscure structural logic by absorbing nonlinear interactions into individual feature scores. Exposing these latent interaction structures is essential for automated auditing in high-stakes environments where understanding the logic of model behavior is as essential as predictive accuracy. Methods: To address this limitation, we introduce the localized case-based feature importance (CBFI) framework. Unlike traditional numerical attribution, our method decomposes instance-specific predictions into structurally distinct components, effectively separating independent main effects (G1) from pure interactions (G4) to capture explicit feature synergies and provide a principled approach for diagnosing feature combinations. translated_title: 超越特征归因：通过局部化CBFI恢复机器学习模型中的潜在交互结构
translated_abstract: 背景：理解复杂表格模型中的个体预测仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的加性框架（如SHAP和LIME）往往通过将非线性交互吸收进单个特征分数而掩盖了结构逻辑。揭示这些潜在交互结构对于高风险环境下的自动化审计至关重要，在这些环境中，理解模型行为的逻辑与预测准确性同等重要。方法：为解决这一局限，我们提出了局部化基于案例的特征重要性（CBFI）框架。与传统的数值归因不同，我们的方法将实例级预测分解为结构上不同的组成部分，有效地将独立主效应（G1）与纯交互效应（G4）分离开来，从而捕捉显式的特征协同作用，并为诊断特征组合提供了一种有原则的方法。结果：在葡萄酒质量分类和医学相关数据集上进行的全面实验……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出局部化CBFI框架，通过将个体预测分解为独立主效应与纯交互效应，恢复了被SHAP和LIME等加性归因方法所掩盖的机器学习模型潜在特征交互结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the localized case-based feature importance (CBFI) framework, which recovers latent feature interaction structures obscured by additive attribution methods like SHAP and LIME by decomposing instance-specific predictions into independent main effects and pure interaction effects.
